newsitem.title: USA: EXXON TEXAS FCC RUNNING AFTER LEAK-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: EXXON TEXAS FCC RUNNING AFTER LEAK-SOURCE.

text.p: Exxon Corp's Baytown, Texas refinery is running its cat cracking unit after a leak and is considering a short shutdown for repair, a company source said.
"It's consuming catalyst right not. The cat unit is not shut yet; we're injecting steam and it will probably limp along and we'll see what happens," the source said.
"It's a serious leak but it's a basic cat cracker problem. There's a meeting right now to decide what to do. It will probably squat for a day if anything (for repair)," the source said.
The source added a major turnaround is scheduled for January.
Exxon's Baytown plant has a cat cracking capacity of 190,000 barrels per day, according to the Oil and Gas Journal.
